finalIntegrationPolicies.undergroundOcean: Hide the global water plane only while rendering an active below-terrain passenger view; restore the prior true/false visibility in finally, including failed renders.
finalIntegrationPolicies.trainPreparation: Precompile only the loaded train subtree with the actual city camera and lighting scene while entry or line change remains busy.
finalIntegrationPolicies.doors: Stationary train body/frame, correct platform side and open-door clearance are required; static cabin wall/glass apertures are adapted on loaded instances.
finalIntegrationPolicies.quality: One active station owner; train LOD selected on load or line change; city Auto uses actual train motion and manual quality remains available.
finalIntegrationPolicies.navigation: Active passengers cannot exit a moving train through city mode switches, direct fly calls or minimap navigation.
finalIntegrationPolicies.waterfrontContinuousTransfer: Exactly two obstructing runtime portal supports are0.22m square visual/collision instances; full public joystick walking to the other line, return to concourse, actual model loading/precompile and successful boarding are regression-tested.

limitations: Original authored representative station geometry and interpolated track depths, not surveyed architecture or photogrammetry.
Offline GTFS-derived route alignment and gameplay timing, not live service or a timetable guarantee.
A fixed standing passenger anchor inside the moving cabin; no free cabin walking, seat selection or intercar traversal.
Main Street source west circulation is not integrated; public access uses the clear east route.
CPU shader-hook and geometry tests are not GPU performance measurements.
